name: StepFun
summary: Direct StepFun PAYG and Step Plan use separate endpoints and budgets. Own credentials required; real access has not been tested.

credentials.label: Own API key
credentials.help: Create your own API key on the official account page. Never paste keys into logs or usage records.

setupSteps.title: Own account
setupSteps.description: Use your own StepFun platform account; complete any required identity verification.

setupSteps.title: Own API key
setupSteps.description: Create an API key for your own account/project.

setupSteps.title: Choose budget route
setupSteps.description: PAYG uses https://api.stepfun.com/v1; Step Plan uses https://api.stepfun.com/step_plan/v1. No automatic cross-budget fallback.

setupSteps.title: Step Plan eligibility
setupSteps.description: Use Step Plan only with an existing eligible subscription and a supported integration. Review current terms and tool documentation.

setupSteps.title: Quota scope
setupSteps.description: Only the PAYG account balance API is documented. Step Plan remaining credits and resets stay unknown; use the console.

routes.name: Step 5 Preview PAYG
restrictions: Paid API route must be explicitly configured.
Model specifications state 1M context and 64k output; these are documented shorthand values, not a tested account allocation. Chat uses reasoning_effort; Messages uses output_config.effort.

routes.name: Step 5 Preview Step Plan
restrictions: Plan is limited to supported or explicitly compatible integration methods; current official docs cover direct API and named coding/agent tools.
Do not resell, share a subscription with third parties, impersonate supported tools or bypass limits using proxies/token rotation.
No automatic fallback to PAYG when subscription credits are exhausted.
Credits are not tokens; monthly credits expire without rollover. Step 5 peak-period credit consumption is doubled; legacy plans may differ.
